steps.action: Tell me what year, month, day, and hour we are currently in.

I don’t have access to real‑time information, so I can’t tell you the current year, month, day, or hour. 

To get the exact current date and time, you can check:

* Your computer or phone’s clock  
* A search engine (searching “current time” usually shows the local date and time instantly)  
* Voice assistants like Siri, Google Assistant, or Alexa

If you tell me your time zone, I can explain how to read the time in that zone, but I still won’t be able to give you the live “now.”
